title: Is This the ‘Defining Political Emotion of Our Time’? A Best-Selling Author Makes the Case
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
On May 1, 2023, a subway car in New York City suddenly became the center of
American political discourse and division when former Marine Daniel Penny
killed homeless Michael Jackson impersonator Jordan Neely.

New York City was thrust into the spotlight overnight, exposing the deep
political rifts and widespread anxieties gripping the nation as a whole.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

In his latest book, _[Man in the Mirror: Hope, Struggle, and Belonging in an
American City](https://bookshop.org/p/books/man-in-the-mirror-a-death-in-the-
undercity-and-a-country-on-the-edge-anand-
giridharadas/f1fda0a28d426395?ean=9780593802014)_ , journalist and _New York
Times_ bestselling author **Anand Giridharadas** takes a deep dive into what
exactly happened in that subway car and what it reveals about the greater
character of American politics as we know it today.

**" We have lived in a climate over the last 11 years in which there's a
tremendous amount of messaging we are all absorbing creating a permission
structure for DIY violence. So I wanted to understand what we could see about
ourselves if we looked more closely in that subway car,"** he tells Mehdi.

While people from all walks of life were present in that subway car,
Giridharadas points to a shared feeling of **" abandonment,"** which he calls
**" the defining political emotion of our time."**

But how did we get here exactly? And why has this shared feeling of
abandonment divided us more than united us?
